question: Which contestant from Kota, Rajasthan, participated in Miss World 2025 but did not make it to the top 8?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nandini Gupta**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Nandini Gupta from Rajasthan participated in the 72nd Miss World pageant in 2025, making it to the top 20 finalists.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Nandini Gupta was crowned Femina Miss India World 2023, which earned her the opportunity to represent India at Miss World 2025.**
 
• The 72nd Miss World pageant was held in Hyderabad in 2025, where Nandini Gupta participated, but did not win the competition.
 
• She successfully made it to the top 20 finalists, which is a significant achievement in the Miss World competition.
 
• A video circulating online that claimed Nandini Gupta won the competition was inaccurate and actually showed her being crowned Femina Miss India World 2023.
